import os,re,glob,time
def text_of(p):
    b=open(p,'rb').read()
    t=b.decode('utf-8','ignore')
    # оставить печатное + переводы строк
    t=''.join(ch if (ch.isprintable() or ch=='\n') else '' for ch in t)
    lines=[l for l in t.split('\n') if l.strip()]
    return lines
for p in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.expanduser("~/.local/share/copyq/copyq/items/*/*/*/*.dat")), key=os.path.getmtime):

    lines=text_of(p)
    joined=' | '.join(lines)
    short = joined[:220] + ('…' if len(joined)>220 else '')
    print(f"[{ts}] {os.path.basename(p)[:12]}  ({len(lines)} стр)  {short}")
